info.title: Callin Public API
info.description: The Callin public API lets you programmatically build and manage AI voice agents, control their knowledge bases, and retrieve call logs and transcripts. All endpoints are versioned under /public/v1.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Service availability check. No authentication required.

tags.name: Identity
tags.description: Verify which account is associated with the current API key.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Create, retrieve, and update AI voice agents.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: List and inspect call logs, transcripts, and conversation details.

tags.name: Knowledge Base
tags.description: Manage documents and groups that agents use during calls.

get.description: Returns 200 OK when the service is running. No authentication required. Use this to verify connectivity or monitor uptime.

200.description: Identity payload for the authenticated API key.

403.description: The API key is invalid or has been revoked (e.g. after regeneration).

get.description: Returns the userId and email associated with the API key in the request. Useful for confirming which account a key belongs to.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter agents by name (case-insensitive partial match).

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to created_at.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort order. Defaults to desc.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response nextCursor. Pass an ISO timestamp when sorting by created_at, or a name string when sorting by name.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of agents per page. Min 1, max 100, default 30.

400.description: One or more query parameters are invalid.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of AI voice agents in your account. Use search to filter by name, sortBy and sortDirection to control ordering, and cursor and pageSize to page through results.

parameters.name: agentId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the agent.

404.description: No agent found with the given agentId.

get.description: Returns the full configuration and metadata for a single agent by its ID.

parameters.name: agentId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the agent to update.

200.description: Agent updated successfully. Returns the full updated agent.

404.description: No agent found with the given agentId.

422.description: Request body failed validation. Check the error field for details.

patch.description: Partially updates an agent. Only fields included in the request body are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged. Returns the full updated agent on success.

200.description: Agent created successfully. Returns the new agent data.

422.description: Request body failed validation. Check the error field for details.

post.description: Creates a new AI voice agent. The name, voice_id, primary_language, prompt, and llm fields are required. All other fields are optional and fall back to sensible defaults.

parameters.name: agentId
parameters.description: Filter conversations to a specific agent.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by conversation status: completed, in_progress, cancelled, failed, or scheduled.

parameters.name: startBeforeUnix
parameters.description: Return conversations that started before this Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds).

parameters.name: startAfterUnix
parameters.description: Return conversations that started after this Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds).

parameters.name: minCallDuration
parameters.description: Return only conversations with a duration of at least this many seconds.

parameters.name: maxCallDuration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: ISO timestamp

200.description: A paginated array of conversation summaries.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of call conversations. Filter by agent, status, date range, or minimum call duration. Use cursor and pageSize to page through large result sets.

parameters.name: conversationId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the conversation.

404.description: No conversation found with the given conversationId.

get.description: Returns full details for a single conversation including the transcript, sentiment analysis, key moments, collected data, and call metadata.

parameters.name: conversationId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the conversation.

200.description: Audio file stream for the call recording.

404.description: No recording found for the given conversationId.

get.description: Returns the audio recording for a conversation. Only available when call recording is enabled on the agent.
